game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the hold guard must hold off yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Then check armor and advance.
player_objective: Protect the frozen well from yeti raiders in Frosted Chapel: keep armor above zero until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 4, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
